data.name: Tommygun's Frag
data.detailed_description:
Tommygun's Frag is a high-intensity, team-based FPS where three squads battle in a relentless arms race to dominate the map. Progression in each match starts from scratch—you spawn in with a sidearm, fight for kills and objectives, and level up your arsenal in real time.

It’s tactical chaos at scale: capture key points, outmaneuver enemy squads, and earn XP and cash to unlock better gear—from SMGs and assault rifles to tanks and attack helicopters. Each match lasts around 30 minutes, and every round is a fresh climb to supremacy.

Tommygun’s Frag features a unique recoil visualization system that lets you see how to control your weapon on-screen during normal gameplay. It not only helps you master recoil patterns, but also enables random recoil that is actually controllable. Even with procedurally generated patterns, you can shoot accurately because they can literally see the gun’s movement before it happens. Some players have called it the “OSU of FPS games,” or “Guitar Hero for recoil patterns.”

  • 3 Teams fight for control of an objective area.  Start each match with a basic sidearm and zero upgrades. Everyone's on equal footing.

  • Capture control zones, defend your turf, and take down enemy players to earn XP and cash.

  • Spend XP to unlock better guns.  Use cash to buy one-life power weapons.

  • Progression resets every round. No long-term grind—just raw, repeatable, adrenaline-fueled chaos.  Can you dominate your way to the top?


Building on the popular Tommygun’s Frag Mod from Rust, this standalone version amps everything up with larger teams, expanded maps, wicked vehicles, and a unique visualized recoil system. No two games play the same—and progression resets every time. Sharpen your skills and race through the weapon tiers faster and faster—mastery is rewarded with dominance!

⚙️ Core Features

  • Recoil Visualization - Easily master recoil patterns with realtime recoil visualization, adapt to procedurally generated patterns -- like its Osu! or Guitar-Hero!

  • 3 Team Warfare – Join one of three teams in objective-based battles that reward teamwork, skill, and map control.  When one team starts snowballing, the other two even things out!

  • Progression-Based Loadouts – Start with a basic kit and earn XP to unlock weapons, armor, attachments, and perks throughout the match.  Progression resets every match, it's a race to get the best weapons first!

  • Tanks & Attack Helicopters – Spend your rewards on calling in serious firepower to give you a power spike in battle.

  • One-Life Upgrades – Spend points on single-life boosts like rocket launchers, heavy armor, and meta weapons.

  • Replayable – Every match resets progression—no grind, no meta attachments, just pure moment-to-moment skill.  The better you get, the faster you progress!

  • Battle-Tested Game Mode - Honed in the crucible of Rust's modding scene over the course of 5 years, a 50,000 monthly active player community awaits your metal.  

  • Play Against Bots - The game supports AI players to practice against and if you want a classic comp-stomp.

If you love the gunplay of Counter-Strike, the progression of MOBAs, and the scale of Battlefield, then FRAG is your next obsession. It’s fast, chaotic, and endlessly replayable.

data.short_description: Born from the hit Rust mod, FRAG is a standalone FPS about momentum and domination. Start with a pistol, frag enemies, and race to unlock better weapons. A first-of-its-kind recoil visualization system shows your recoil as you fire, letting you outskill opponents.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570, 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1080p, Low settings, ~30 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 Ti / AMD Radeon RX Vega 56, 8 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1080p High / 1440p Medium, ~60 FPS

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent depictions of violence in a sci-fi setting. Players engage in first-person combat using firearms, explosives, and melee attacks against other players and computer-controlled enemies. Combat includes gunfire, energy weapons, and blood effects when characters are damaged or defeated.

There are no sexual themes, nudity, or depictions of sexual assault. The game does not contain portrayals of drug use, self-harm, or similar sensitive subject matter.
